Class BlockStateProviderBase

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.client.data.models.ModelProvider
org.moddingx.libx.datagen.provider.model.BlockStateProviderBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.data.DataProvider, net.neoforged.neoforge.client.extensions.IModelProviderExtension
public abstract class BlockStateProviderBase extends net.minecraft.client.data.models.ModelProvider
A base class for block state and model providers. An extending class should call the manualState(Block) and manualModel(Block) methods in setup().

    • setTranslucent

      protected void setTranslucent(boolean translucent)
      Sets whether the materials generated from here on are marked as translucent. Like the render type it replaces, this stays in effect until it is changed again, so it is typically set in setup() around the blocks that need it. Translucency is a property of the material in this version, not a render type on the model. A block whose texture has partially transparent pixels needs this, or those pixels are drawn as fully opaque or fully cut out.

    • material

      protected net.minecraft.client.resources.model.sprite.Material material(net.minecraft.resources.Identifier texture)
      Creates a Material for the given texture. Every material this provider generates goes through here, so overriding this is the way to customize them beyond setTranslucent(boolean).
